column1: # Compile-only probes of the boundaries of the 3502 function-coercion rule (#724; docs/LANGUAGE.md, "Function values Epic's compiler does not convert"). Each asks UEFN 43.12 (++Fortnite+Release-43.12-CL-60598086) about one construct; Epic compiled each alone on 2026-11-19 (~15:40Z): epic_outcome, epic_lines (1-based body lines of the probe file, the header included) and Epic's diagnostics in note, with OpenVerse's verdict (Lean and C agreeing) after the rule was widened to every function value that is no name (31 agreed before, 36 agree now; value-class-variance still differs: openverse has no class variance for function values).
